author: CBR
description:
Hot take: Ben Affleck is a great Batman… and the argument is that he might be the best live-action version. 

The case is simple: he’s a grizzled veteran Batman who looks like he’s been through wars, the warehouse fight is an all-timer, his Bruce Wayne actually works, and the Alfred dynamic is one of the strongest in the DC movies.
